svg.title: Diclofenac EIC and simulated m/z peak width at three resolving powers
svg.desc: Three columns compare illustrative diclofenac EICs sampled once per modeled scan cycle with simulated m/z values. Each intensity panel is normalized to its own MS1 apex and uses relative arbitrary units, so cross-instrument absolute intensity is not compared. Each cycle records either one MS1 or one MS2 scan on a fixed event-time grid. After every second high-intensity MS1, the next cycle is an MS2 scan. The EIC has a 10 second FWHM; cycle intervals are 0.5, 0.8, and 2 seconds. The lower m/z plot shows MS1 measurements and red markers for the selected diclofenac precursor during MS2 cycles; these markers are not fragment ions. The lower-resolution TOF case has the widest mass peak; Orbitrap 60k is narrower and Orbitrap 120k is narrowest.
svg.text: MS2 cycle (selected precursor; after 2nd high-signal MS1)
